typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Playfair Display (for contrast/editorial feel)

colors.background: #050505 (Deep Void Black, NEVER pure black or gray)

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10
surfaces.cards: Neumorphism/Tactile mix: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 shadow-2xl hover:border-white/20 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle radial blue/cyan glows in the background to simulate 3D light bleed. No heavy linear gradients on backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use 1px borders to ground elements. Use high contrast.

components.navigation: Sticky top header (z-50), logo on top-left (User provided logo, use an tag assuming it's in public folder, or a highly polished text fallback with blue arrow icon). Add EL/EN language switcher toggle.
components.hero: Massive typography. Left aligned or center. Include the glossy 3D crystal abstract image as a floating element or background texture. CTA should be a premium pill-shaped button.
components.counter_section: Scroll-triggered animated counter using framer-motion (useInView, useSpring). Must count up to '100' and append '+ Million Views'. Make the numbers massive (text-7xl+).
components.services: Bento Grid layout (Mode A). Dark cards with glowing hover borders (Tracing Beam effect). Highlight TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube video production.
components.clients_marquee: Smooth infinite carousel using react-fast-marquee. CRITICAL: The user wants 28 specific client logos without 'ugly corners' or 'deadspace'. DO NOT TRY TO USE RANDOM IMAGE URLS for them. Instead, create a beautiful <ClientLogo /> component that pairs a relevant lucide-react icon (e.g., Utensils for restaurants, Scissors for hair salons) with the client's name in crisp white/gray typography. This guarantees 100% clean, premium, and zero-deadspace results.
components.contact_form: Minimalist premium form (Name, Email, Message). MUST send real email to 'socialstartupagency@gmail.com'. Use 'https://formsubmit.co/socialstartupagency@gmail.com' as the form action, or implement Web3Forms.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections should have py-24 or py-32. Containers must have internal padding (p-6 to p-8) if they have borders.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical grids for services. 1 col mobile, 3-4 col desktop.

motion.scrolling: Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis is highly recommended if applicable, otherwise native smooth scroll).
motion.animations: Framer Motion for staggered fade-ups on text and bento cards. The client marquee must be perfectly smooth.

images.description: Multi-faceted crystal shapes for glossy 3D feel to match the brand logo vibe.
Blue wave neon light on dark background. Use as a subtle screen-blended background layer.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Use .js (JavaScript) files for React, NOT .tsx, as specified in the rules.
Create a bilingual context or simple state to switch text between Greek (EL) and English (EN). Default to Greek.

For the 28 clients, iterate over 'client_list_data'. Map each string to a
{name}
. Assign appropriate Lucide icons based on the name (e.g. coffee for BlyssCafe, car for Euthimiou Cars).
Form submission: <form action='https://formsubmit.co/socialstartupagency@gmail.com' method='POST'>. This solves the email requirement natively.
Use framer-motion to animate the '100' counter smoothly as the user scrolls to it.
Follow the 'Dark Premium' aesthetic rigorously. No generic Vercel templates. Use true black/dark gray backgrounds with blue neon glows.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='lang-switcher', data-testid='contact-submit').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Always use modern interactive states (hover/focus). Implement micro-animations for all interactive elements. Use glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) for sticky elements. Create depth with z-index. Do not use generic gradient slop; use subtle radial glows.
